_comment: Reviewed exemptions for framework-header-parity-gate.py. Each entry is one framework-prefixed header spelling a language package emits that is NOT a registered wire name (datrix_common.generation.http_headers). A private spelling of a framework contract is a defect; an entry here records the one reviewed reason it is still allowed, and a new spelling never hides behind an old one because every entry is matched against a live spelling. Remove the entry in the same change that fixes the package.

exemptions.reason: java's trusted-caller filter validates a shared secret on this private header instead of the managed-identity JWT on the registered caller-token header, and its dependency client sends no caller header. The family is declared unrealized on JAVA_CAPABILITY_DECLARATION; realizing the shared contract removes this spelling and this entry together.
